snippet.title: Idle Research 2 // Teaser
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3420280/Idle_Research_2/

Idle Research 2 is an addictive, heavily-layered, incremental game themed around energy and resource management. It brings strategy, QOL, and feature synergism to the next level. The game takes place in 2070 on planet Mu Ra Tempel after the devastating Earth-27 Mutually Assured Destruction incident.

Developed by
Considera Games LLC aka @ConsideraCore
